timing_scope.warm: repeated same operands in CUDA graph, warm cache
timing_scope.cold: L2-sized independent buffer read/write before every single-operation graph event interval
timing_scope.deepgemm: SA.float(), SB.float(), any DeepGEMM internal scale layout kernels, and GEMM included; no preconverted scale reuse
timing_scope.excluded: weight I/O, activation quantization, JIT, graph construction, eviction, Python allocation/dispatch overhead
timing_scope.eager: separate Python wall time includes complete adapter allocation/dispatch; warm cache
timing_scope.bandwidth: logical operand/output footprint divided by elapsed time; not measured hardware DRAM traffic
timing_scope.cache_limit: capacity overwrite perturbs L2; no hardware guarantee that every prior line is invalidated
